blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate ground-based cloud classification is important for atmospheric monitoring, solar-energy forecasting, aviation weather assessment, and climate observation systems. However, reliable sky-image annotation is time-consuming, especially when cloud types are visually similar or mixed. In this work, we study the label efficiency of deep learning for ground-based cloud classification using the Ground-based Cloud Dataset (GCD). Rather than proposing a new architecture, we benchmark three practical learning strategies under limited annotation budgets: supervised transfer learning, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling. An ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 is used as a common frozen backbone, and experiments are repeated over five random seeds for label budgets ranging from 1 % 1\% to 100 % 100\% of the training labels. Supervised transfer learning is already highly label-efficient: test accuracy increases from 0.635 ± 0.018 0.635\pm 0.018 with 1 % 1\% labels to 0.730 ± 0.002 0.730\pm 0.002 with 40 % 40\% labels, approaching the full-label performance of 0.735 ± 0.003 0.735\pm 0.003 . Active learning and pseudo-labeling are competitive with supervised sampling and provide small improvements for some metrics and budgets, but neither produces a large or consistent aggregate gain. Diagnostic analyses show that accepted pseudo-labels are highly reliable, with accuracy ranging from 0.946 0.946 to 0.977 0.977 , but are biased toward easier, high-confidence sky-type groups. In contrast, uncertainty sampling preferentially queries uncertain samples from visually challenging groups, including Mixed and the visually confusable Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups, but these targeted acquisitions yield only modest performance improvements. Overall, these results show that transfer learning can substantially reduce annotation requirements for GCD, while simple active and semi-supervised strategies provide limited additional gains over a strong supervised baseline.
blocks.zh: 准确的地基云分级对大气监测,太阳能预报,航空天气评估和气候观测系统具有重要意义. 然而,可靠的天空图像注释是耗时的,特别是当云类型在视觉上相似或混合时. 在这项工作中,我们利用地基云数据集(GCD)研究地基云分级深层学习的标签效率. 我们没有提出新的架构,而是在有限的注释预算下,将三项实用学习战略作为基准:有监督的转移学习、基于不确定性的积极学习和高自信的假标签。 一个ImageNet-pressed ResNet50被用作常见的被冷冻的骨干,并重复了五个随机种子的实验,用于标签预算,范围从培训标签的1%~%到100%~100~%不等. 监督转录学习已经具有很高的标签效率:测试精度由0.635±0.018 0.635\pm 0.018,标签为1% 1+% 升至0.730±0.002 0.730\pm 0.002,标签为40% 40+% ,接近0.735±0.003 0.735\pm 0.003的全标签性能. 积极的学习和伪标签与受监督的抽样具有竞争力,为一些计量和预算提供了小的改进,但两者都无法产生大或一致的总收益。 诊断分析显示被接受的伪标签非常可靠,准确度从0.946 0.946到0.977 0.977不等,但偏好于更简单,高自信的天空型组. 与此相反,不确定性取样倾向于从视力有挑战性的群体,包括混合群体和可视相容的Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus群体,对不确定的样本进行查询,但这些有针对性地采购只产生有限的性能改进。 总的来说,这些结果表明,转学学习可以大大减少GCD的注解要求,而简单的主动和半监督战略比强有力的监督基线提供有限的额外收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cloud observation is essential for weather monitoring, climate research, solar energy forecasting, aviation weather assessment, and local environmental observation. Cloud type, structure, and temporal evolution influence radiative transfer, precipitation processes, surface irradiance, and short-term atmospheric conditions ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Lv et al., 2022 ) . Ground-based sky imaging complements satellite observations by providing local, high-resolution views of cloud fields from below. Such images are therefore useful for operational tasks such as sky-condition assessment, cloud-type classification, and short-term forecasting.
blocks.zh: 云观测对于天气监测,气候研究,太阳能预报,航空天气评估,以及地方环境观测至关重要. 云的类型,结构和时间演化会影响辐射转移,降水过程,地表辐射,以及短期大气条件(张等,2018;Lv等,2022. 地基天空成像通过从下方提供云场的局部高分辨率视图来补充卫星观测. 因此,这些图像对诸如天候评估、云型分类和短期预测等业务任务有用。

blocks.en: Automatic ground-based cloud classification remains a challenging task. Cloud categories are often difficult to distinguish, particularly when cloud fields contain multiple cloud types or exhibit gradual transitions between morphologies. Some classes, such as clear sky, are relatively easy to identify, whereas others, including altocumulus, stratocumulus, cumulonimbus, and mixed cloud scenes, can share similar texture, illumination, scale, and shape. Early cloud classification approaches relied on hand-crafted features, such as colour, texture, and statistical descriptors. More recently, deep learning has significantly improved image-based cloud classification by learning features directly from data, and convolutional neural networks and related architectures have become widely used for this task ( Li et al., 2023 ; Lv et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 自动地基云分类仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。 云类往往难以区分,特别是当云域包含多类云或呈现出形态相间的逐渐过渡. 一些类,如晴天等,相对容易识别;而其他类,包括上积分,上积分,上积分,上积分,下积分等,和混合云场景,则可以共享相似的纹理,发光,尺度和形状. 早期的云分类方法依赖于手工制作的特征,如颜色,纹理和统计描述. 最近,深入学习通过直接从数据中学习特征,大大地改进了以图像为基础的云分级,而进化神经网络和相关架构被广泛用于这一任务(Li等,2023;Lv等,2022.).

blocks.en: Most recent work on ground-based cloud classification has focused on model design. Proposed methods include lightweight convolutional networks, graph-based models, attention mechanisms, transformer-inspired architectures, and hybrid feature-fusion approaches ( Li et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2020 ) . These studies show that specialised deep networks can achieve strong classification performance on public cloud-image datasets. However, practical deployment depends not only on architecture, but also on annotation cost. In many observational settings, labelled cloud images are expensive to obtain because reliable annotation requires domain expertise, consistent interpretation across cloud categories, and careful handling of ambiguous or mixed cases. Therefore, an important practical question is not only which architecture achieves the highest performance with fully labelled data, but also how much labelled data is required to achieve useful classification performance.
blocks.zh: 最近关于地基云分级的作品主要集中于模型设计. 拟议方法包括:轻量级演化网络、以图表为基础的模型、注意机制、变压器启发式建筑和混合特征融合方法(Li等,2023;Shi等,2024;Li等,2022;Liu等,2020)。 这些研究表明,专门的深层网络可以在公共云成数据集上实现强的分类性能. 然而,实际部署不仅取决于结构,也取决于注释费用。 在许多观测环境中,贴有标签的云图象需要花费很多钱才能获得,因为可靠的注释需要域名专门知识,云类之间一致的解释,以及谨慎处理模棱两可或混合的情况. 因此,一个重要的实际问题不仅在于哪个架构用全标签数据实现了最高性能,而且需要多少标签数据才能实现有用的分类性能.

blocks.en: Label-efficient learning addresses this question by reducing dependence on manually labelled data. In remote sensing, label scarcity has motivated transfer learning, self-supervised learning, semi-supervised learning, and active learning approaches ( Wang et al., 2022b ) . In ground-based cloud classification, contrastive self-supervised learning has been proposed as a way to reduce dependence on labelled data ( Lv et al., 2022 ) . Pseudo-labeling provides another simple semi-supervised strategy: a model trained on a small labelled subset assigns labels to high-confidence unlabelled samples, which are then used for further training. Active learning takes a different approach by selecting unlabelled samples that are expected to provide the greatest information gain, such as those for which model predictions are most uncertain. Both strategies are attractive in cloud-image analysis, where large collections of unlabelled sky images are often available while expert-labelled data remain limited.
blocks.zh: 标签高效的学习通过减少对人工标记数据的依赖来解决这一问题. 在遥感方面,标签稀缺激发了转移学习,自我监督学习,半监督学习,主动学习的方法(Wang等,2022b.). 在地基云分级中,有人提出将对比自学作为减少对被标注数据依赖的方法(Lv等,2022.). Pseudo-labeling提供了另一种简单的半监督策略:在被贴上小标签的子集上训练的模型将标签指定给高自信无标签的样本,然后用于进一步培训. 积极的学习采取不同的方法,选择无标签的样本,这些样本可望带来最大的信息收益,例如模型预测最不确定的样本. 这两种战略在云映分析中都具有吸引力,在云映分析中,经常有大量无标签的天空图像,而专家标记的数据仍然有限。

blocks.en: Despite this motivation, there is still a need for a systematic empirical benchmark of label-efficient methods for ground-based cloud classification. In particular, it is important to compare active learning and pseudo-labeling against a strong supervised transfer-learning baseline under the same label budgets. Such a benchmark should evaluate not only overall classification accuracy, but also class-balanced performance metrics, variability across random seeds, and diagnostic analyses that explain why label-efficient strategies do or do not improve performance. This is especially important for imbalanced cloud datasets, where high overall accuracy can hide poor performance on minority or visually ambiguous classes.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这一积极性,但仍有必要为地基云分级制定具有标签效率的系统经验基准。 特别是,必须将积极学习和假标签与同一标签预算下强有力的监督转移学习基线进行比较。 这种基准不仅应评价总的分类准确性,还应评价阶级平衡的性能衡量标准、随机种子的可变性以及诊断分析,以解释为什么标签效率高的战略能够或不能提高性能。 这对于不平衡的云数据集尤其重要,因为整体精确度高可能掩盖少数群体或视觉上模棱两可的阶层的不良表现。

blocks.en: In this study, we focus on the practical problem of reducing annotation requirements for ground-based cloud classification. Using the Ground-based Cloud Dataset (GCD), we evaluate whether simple label-efficient learning strategies can improve upon a strong supervised transfer-learning baseline. Rather than proposing a new neural-network architecture, the aim is to provide a controlled benchmark and diagnostic analysis of when active and semi-supervised strategies are useful in this setting.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们注重减少地基云分级的注释要求的实际问题. 我们利用地基云数据集(GCD),评价简单的标签高效学习战略能否在强有力的有监督的转移学习基线基础上得到改进。 其目的不是提出新的神经网络架构,而是提供一种可控的基准和诊断分析,说明在何种情况下积极和半监督的战略是有用的。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows: • We quantify the supervised label-efficiency curve of frozen ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 on GCD, showing how performance changes as the labelled training budget increases. • We compare supervised stratified random sampling, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling under matched label budgets, a fixed training protocol, and five random seeds. • We evaluate performance using overall and class-balanced metrics, including accuracy, macro-F1 score, balanced accuracy, weighted-F1 score, and per-class F1 scores. • We analyse pseudo-label coverage, accepted accuracy, rejected prediction accuracy, confidence, and class-relative selection within the unlabelled training pool. • We examine active-learning query enrichment relative to the remaining unlabelled pool to determine whether uncertainty sampling preferentially selects visually ambiguous cloud categories.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下: 我们量化GCD上被冻结的ImageNet-pressed ResNet50的有监督的标签效率曲线,显示随着标有标签的培训预算增加,业绩的变化。 我们比较有监督的分层随机抽样、基于不确定性的主动学习和在相应的标签预算、固定的训练规程和五个随机种子下的高自信伪标签。 我们使用总体和班级平衡的衡量标准来评价业绩,包括准确性、宏观-F1分、平衡性、加权-F1分和每等F1分。 我们分析无标签培训人才库内的伪标签覆盖面、接受的准确性、被拒绝的预测准确性、信心和类相对选择。 我们对照剩余的未加标签的集合,审查积极学习的查询丰富性,以确定不确定性取样是否优先选择视觉模糊的云类。

blocks.en: We quantify the supervised label-efficiency curve of frozen ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 on GCD, showing how performance changes as the labelled training budget increases.
blocks.zh: 我们量化GCD上被冻结的ImageNet-pressed ResNet50的有监督的标签效率曲线,显示随着标注的培训预算增加,性能如何变化.

blocks.en: We compare supervised stratified random sampling, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling under matched label budgets, a fixed training protocol, and five random seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了有监督的分层随机抽样,基于不确定性的主动学习, 以及高度自信的伪标签 在匹配的标签预算,固定的训练协议, 和五个随机种子。

blocks.zh: 我们使用总体和班级平衡的衡量标准来评价业绩,包括准确度,宏-F1分,平衡准确度,加权-F1分,以及每等F1分.

blocks.zh: 我们分析假标签覆盖度,接受的准确性,拒绝的预测准确性,信心,以及未加标签的培训人才库中与班级相适应的选择.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Ground-based cloud image classification
blocks.zh: 2.1 地基云图像分类

blocks.en: Ground-based cloud classification has been studied using both traditional image-processing methods and modern deep-learning approaches. Early methods relied on hand-crafted descriptors designed to capture colour, texture, shape, and local image structure. Representative examples include feature extraction from whole-sky images, automatic whole-sky cloud classification, block-based statistical and texture descriptors, weighted local binary patterns, and texton-based representations ( Calbó and Sabburg, 2008 ; Heinle et al., 2010 ; Cheng and Yu, 2015 ; Liu et al., 2015 ; Dev et al., 2015 ) . Later descriptor-based approaches used region covariance descriptors and Riemannian bag-of-features representations to improve ground-based cloud classification ( Tang et al., 2021 ) . These methods provided important baselines, but their performance depends strongly on the quality of the manually designed representation and can be limited by the large intra-class variability of cloud images.
blocks.zh: 利用传统图像处理方法和现代深层学习方法研究了地基云分类。 早期的方法依赖于手工制作的描述器,旨在捕捉出颜色,纹理,外形,以及局部图像结构. 具有代表性的例子包括:从全天空图像取出地物,自动全天空云分类,以块为基础的统计和纹理描述符,加权本地二进制图案,以及以文本为基础的表述(Calbó和Sabburg,2008年;Heinle等,2010年;Cheng和Yu,2015年;Liu等,2015年;Dev等,2015年)。 后来基于描述法的方法使用区域同位素描述法和Riemannian bag-features表达法来改进地基云分级(Tang等人,2021年). 这些方法提供了重要的基线,但其性能在很大程度上取决于人工设计的代表质量,并可受云图像在类内的巨大可变性所限制.

blocks.en: Deep learning has substantially changed the methodology for ground-based cloud classification by allowing feature representations to be learned directly from images. DeepCloud showed that convolutional visual features extracted from convolutional neural networks can improve ground-based cloud image categorization compared with traditional descriptors ( Ye et al., 2017 ) . CloudNet proposed a dedicated convolutional neural-network for meteorological cloud classification and introduced the Cirrus Cumulus Stratus Nimbus (CCSN) dataset with cloud categories under meteorological standards ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Subsequent studies developed more specialised architectures, including graph convolutional models, heterogeneous feature-learning methods, attention-based networks, transformer-inspired models, and hybrid CNN–transformer approaches ( Liu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 深入学习大大改变了地基云分级的方法,使地物说明直接从图像中学习。 DeepCloud 显示,从革命神经网络中提取出入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 CloudNet提出了气象云分级的专用演化神经网络,并引入了Cirrus Cumulus Stratus Nimbus(CCSN)数据集,在气象标准下有云类(张等,2018年). 随后的研究开发了更专业的架构,包括图解式模型、不同的特征学习方法、基于注意力的网络、变压器启发模型、以及混合式CNN-transformer方法(Liu等,2020年;Liu等,2022年;Li等,2022年)。

blocks.en: Recent work has also focused on models designed for larger public ground-based cloud datasets. CloudDenseNet proposed a lightweight reconstructed DenseNet architecture and evaluated it on large-scale ground-based cloud datasets, including GCD ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Improved RepVGG-style models with attention mechanisms have similarly been proposed to capture both local texture and longer-range spatial structure in cloud images ( Shi et al., 2024 ) . These architecture-focused studies demonstrate the strong performance of deep networks for cloud classification. However, they typically evaluate performance using the available labelled training set, whereas the question of how performance changes under systematically reduced label budgets has received less attention.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还侧重于为更大的公共地基云数据集所设计的模型. CloudDenseNet提出了轻量级重建的DenseNet架构,并在包括GCD(Li等,2023年)在内的大型地基云数据集上进行了评价. 改进后具有注意机制的RepVGG型模型也同样被提议在云图中捕捉出局部纹理和更远的空间结构(Shi等人,2024年)。 这些以架构为重点的研究表明了深层云分级网络的强效性能. 然而,它们通常使用现有的有标签的培训组合来评价业绩,而有系统减少的有标签预算下的业绩变化问题却没有得到多少重视。

blocks.en: 2.2 Label scarcity and label-efficient learning in remote sensing
blocks.zh: 2.2 标签稀缺和标签效率高的遥感学习

blocks.en: Label scarcity is a common challenge in remote sensing and environmental image analysis. Labelling often requires expert knowledge, quality control, and consistency across sensors, locations, and acquisition conditions. In ground-based cloud classification, these difficulties are amplified by mixed cloud fields, ambiguous visual boundaries, and gradual transitions between cloud types. Label-efficient learning is therefore important for deploying cloud-classification systems in new observational settings.
blocks.zh: 标签稀缺是遥感和环境图像分析中常见的挑战. 标签往往需要专家知识、质量控制以及传感器、地点和获取条件的一致性。 在地基云分级中,这些困难被混合云场,模糊的视觉界限所放大,并逐渐地在云类型之间过渡. 因此,标签高效的学习对于在新的观测环境中部署云分类系统十分重要。

blocks.en: Several label-efficient learning paradigms have been explored in remote sensing, including transfer learning, self-supervised learning, semi-supervised learning, and active learning. Transfer learning is particularly attractive when the target dataset is not large enough to train a deep model from scratch. A model pretrained on a large image dataset can provide generic visual features, while the final layers are adapted to the target task. In this work, we use ResNet50 as the shared backbone, following the residual-learning framework introduced by He et al. (2016) , and initialise the model with ImageNet-pretrained weights, following the transfer-learning paradigm enabled by large-scale datasets such as ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) . This provides a strong supervised baseline against which active learning and pseudo-labeling can be evaluated.
blocks.zh: 在遥感领域探索了几种具有标签效率的学习范式,包括转移学习,自学监督学习,半自学监督学习,主动学习等. 当目标数据集不够大,不足以从零开始训练深层模型时,转移学习特别有吸引力. 一个在大型图像数据集上预先训练的模型可以提供通用的视觉特征,而最终的地层则被适应目标任务. 在这项工作中,我们使用ResNet50作为共享的骨干,遵循He等人(University)推出的剩余学习框架,并按照ImageNet等大型数据集所启用的转移学习模式(Deng等人,2009年),使用ImageNet预先受限的权重对模型进行登录。 这为积极学习和假贴标签提供了强有力的监督基线。

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning is another strategy for reducing dependence on labels. In remote sensing, self-supervised approaches have been studied as a way to exploit large unlabelled image archives ( Wang et al., 2022b ) . In ground-based cloud classification, contrastive self-supervised learning has been used to learn cloud-image representations before supervised classification ( Lv et al., 2022 ) . Our study is related in motivation, but different in scope: instead of proposing a new representation-learning method, we benchmark simple and reproducible label-efficient strategies under matched annotation budgets.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习是减少对标签依赖的又一策略. 在遥感方面,作为利用大型无标签图像档案的方法,研究了自我监督的方法(Wang等,2022b.). 在地基云分類中,相對自監學被用来在被監督分類前学习出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 我们的研究与动机相关,但范围不同:我们没有提出一种新的代表性学习方法,而是根据相应的注释预算,将简单和可复制的标签效率战略作为基准。

blocks.en: 2.3 Active learning for remote sensing classification
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 积极学习遥感分类.

blocks.en: Active learning aims to reduce annotation cost by selecting informative unlabelled samples for labelling ( Settles, 2009 ) . In remote sensing, active learning has long been studied because labelled data are expensive and random sampling may not capture the full spatial, spectral, or visual diversity of the data. Common strategies include uncertainty sampling, margin sampling, entropy-based criteria, query-by-committee, and diversity-aware selection. Surveys of active learning in remote sensing emphasise that training-set quality is critical for classification performance and that uncertainty-based heuristics provide simple and practical sample-selection rules ( Tuia et al., 2011 ) .
blocks.zh: 积极学习旨在通过选择信息性无标签标注的标本来降低注释成本(Setters,2009年)。 在遥感中,主动学习长期被研究,因为被贴上标签的数据很昂贵,随机取样可能无法捕捉数据的全部空间,光谱,或视觉多样性. 共同的战略包括不确定性取样、比值取样、以蕨类为主的标准、逐一查询和对多样性的认识选择。 对遥感积极学习的调查强调,培训质量对分类绩效至关重要,基于不确定性的休眠法提供了简单而实用的样本选择规则(Tuia等,2011年)。

blocks.en: Deep active learning extends these ideas to neural networks and large image archives. Recent work in remote-sensing image classification has considered single-label, multi-class, and multi-label settings, often combining uncertainty with diversity to avoid selecting redundant samples ( Möllenbrok et al., 2023 ) . These studies motivate active learning as a practical strategy for reducing annotation cost in remote-sensing classification. In the present study, we examine whether this strategy provides additional benefit over a strong transfer-learning baseline for ground-based cloud classification.
blocks.zh: 深度活性学习将这些想法扩展到神经网络和大型图像档案. 最近在遥感图像分类方面的工作考虑了单一标签、多类和多标签设置,往往将不确定性与多样性结合起来,以避免选择多余的样本(Möllenbrok等,2023年)。 这些研究激励积极学习,作为降低遥感分类中注释成本的实用战略. 在本研究中,我们审查这项战略是否比地面云分级的强有力的转移学习基线提供了额外好处。

blocks.en: 2.4 Pseudo-labeling and semi-supervised learning
blocks.zh: 2.4 贴标签和半监督学习

blocks.en: Semi-supervised learning uses both labelled and unlabelled data during training. Pseudo-labeling is one of the simplest semi-supervised strategies: a model trained on labelled data predicts labels for unlabelled samples, and high-confidence predictions are treated as additional training labels ( Lee and others, 2013 ) . This approach is attractive because it is easy to implement and can be applied to standard supervised architectures. However, its effectiveness depends strongly on pseudo-label quality. Incorrect pseudo-labels can reinforce model errors, while overly conservative thresholds may select mostly easy examples and add little new information.
blocks.zh: 半监督学习在培训期间使用标有标签和无标签的数据。 Pseudo-labeling是最简单的半监督策略之一:一个接受过标签数据培训的模型预测了无标签样本的标签,而高自信预测则被视为附加培训标签(Lee等,2013年). . 这种方法具有吸引力,因为它易于实施,可以被应用于标准监督架构. 然而,其有效性在很大程度上取决于伪标签的质量。 错误的伪标签可以强化模型错误,而过于保守的阈值则可能选择大多数容易的例子并添加很少的新信息.

blocks.en: Pseudo-labeling and related semi-supervised methods have been studied in remote sensing, especially for scene classification and semantic segmentation, where annotation costs are high ( Wang et al., 2022a ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Ran et al., 2025 ) . These studies highlight both the potential and the limitations of pseudo-label-based learning. Reliable pseudo-labels can improve performance, but noisy or class-biased pseudo-labels may limit gains. Because pseudo-labeling can be affected by confirmation errors and class bias, diagnostic analyses of pseudo-label quality are important when evaluating semi-supervised methods.
blocks.zh: 在遥感方面研究了Pseudo标签及相关的半监督方法,特别是场景分类和语义分解,其中注解成本高(Wang等人,2022a; Feng等,2025;Ran等,2025). 这些研究突出了以假标签为基础的学习的潜力和局限性。 可靠的伪标签可以提高性能,但吵闹或有阶级偏见的伪标签可能会限制收益. 由于伪标签可能受确认错误和类偏差的影响,因此对伪标签质量的诊断分析在评价半监督方法时很重要.

blocks.en: 2.5 Positioning of this work
blocks.zh: 2.5 这项工作的位置

blocks.en: The existing literature shows that deep learning can achieve strong ground-based cloud classification performance, and that label-efficient learning is important in remote sensing. However, architecture-focused cloud-classification studies do not directly answer how much labelled data is needed, or whether simple active and semi-supervised strategies improve over a strong transfer-learning baseline. This study addresses that gap by focusing on annotation efficiency rather than architectural novelty.
blocks.zh: 现有文献显示,深入学习可以实现强大的地基云分级性能,而标签高效的学习在遥感中是重要的. 然而,注重架构的云分类研究并没有直接回答需要多少标签数据,或者简单的主动和半监督战略是否比强健的转移学习基线有所改进. 本研究通过注重说明效率而不是建筑新颖性来解决这一差距。

blocks.en: 3 Materials and methods
blocks.zh: 3 材料和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset and data partitioning
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和数据分区

blocks.en: Experiments were conducted using the publicly available Ground-based Cloud Dataset, which contains seven sky-type groups defined according to the International Cloud Classification System and practical visual similarity. The seven GCD groups are: Cumulus; Altocumulus/Cirrocumulus; Cirrus/Cirrostratus; Clear sky; Stratocumulus/Stratus/Altostratus; Cumulonimbus/Nimbostratus; and Mixed cloud. Images with cloudiness no greater than 10% are included in the Clear sky group ( Liu et al., 2022 ) . For readability, we use shortened labels throughout the manuscript: Cumulus, Altocumulus, Cirrus, Clear sky, Stratocumulus, Cumulonimbus, and Mixed. These shortened labels refer to the corresponding GCD sky-type groups rather than to individual cloud types. We use this convention consistently in figures, tables, and the subsequent analysis.
blocks.zh: 利用公开的地基云数据集进行了实验,该数据集包含根据国际云分系统定义的7个天型组和实际视觉相似性. 7个GCD组分别是: Cumulus; Altocumulus/ Cirrocumulus; Cirrus/ Cirrostratus; Clear sky; Stratocumulus/ Stratus/ Altostratus; Cumulonimbus/ Nimbostratus;和混合云. 有云度不超过10%的图像被包含入"清空"组(刘等,2022). 关于可读性,我们在整个手稿中使用了缩短的标签:Cumulus、Altocumulus、Cirrus、Clear Sky、Stratocumulus、Cumulonimbus和Mixed。 这些被缩短的标签指的是相应的GCD天型组,而不是单个云型. 我们在数字、表格和随后的分析中一贯使用这项公约。

blocks.en: The dataset comprises a 10,000-image training set and an independent 9,000-image test set. Representative examples from each GCD sky-type group are shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 该数据集包括一套10 000个图像培训单元和一个9 000个独立图像测试单元。 图1显示了每个GCD天空类型组的代表实例。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Representative training images from the seven GCD sky-type groups. Shortened labels are used for readability and refer to the corresponding GCD sky-type groups. The examples illustrate both visually distinctive groups, such as Clear sky, and more visually ambiguous groups, such as Mixed, Stratocumulus, and Cumulonimbus.
blocks.zh: 图1:7个GCD天型团体的代表训练影像. 缩短的标签用于可读性,并指相应的GCD天型组. 这些例子既说明有视觉特征的群体,如Clear Sky;也说明有视觉模糊的群体,如Mixed、Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus。

blocks.en: In the final benchmark, no labelled validation subset was used for model selection. Instead, label-budget subsets were sampled from the full training set, and fixed training schedules were used across all methods, label budgets, and random seeds. Thus, the reported label budgets correspond directly to the labelled images used for model optimisation, without an additional labelled validation resource. The independent test set was loaded without shuffling and was used exclusively for final performance evaluation. It was excluded from training, pseudo-label generation, active-learning sample acquisition, hyperparameter selection, and all other model-development steps.
blocks.zh: 在最终基准中,没有使用标有标签的验证子集来选择模型. 相反,从整套培训中抽取了标签预算子集,并对所有方法、标签预算和随机种子采用了固定的培训时间表。 因此,所报告的标签预算直接对应用于模型优化的标签图像,没有额外的标签验证资源。 独立测试集的装入没有被打乱,专门用于最终性能评价. 它被排除在培训、伪标签生成、主动学习样本采集、超参数选择和所有其他模型开发步骤之外。

blocks.en: The dataset exhibits substantial class imbalance. Within the training set, the Cumulonimbus group was the largest (3,003 images), whereas the Mixed group was the smallest (348 images). A similar distribution was observed in the independent test set. The complete distribution of the seven GCD sky-type groups is presented in Table 1 .

blocks.zh: 表1:7GCD天空型组在培训和独立测试集中的分布. 标签预算子集从完整的一万像训练集中抽取,没有额外的标签验证子集用于模型选择.

blocks.en: The class imbalance motivated the use of class-sensitive evaluation metrics in addition to overall accuracy. Specifically, macro-F1 score and balanced accuracy were included to ensure that performance on majority groups did not obscure weaker performance on minority or visually ambiguous cloud categories.
blocks.zh: 班级失衡促使除了总体准确性外,还使用对班级敏感的评价指标。 具体地说,列入宏观-F1分和平衡的准确性,以确保多数群体的业绩不会掩盖少数群体或视似模糊的云类方面较弱的业绩。

blocks.en: 3.2 Image preprocessing and data pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 图像预处理和数据管道

blocks.en: All images were loaded using the TensorFlow/Keras image data pipeline. Images were resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels, corresponding to the standard input resolution used by ResNet50. Before being passed to the network, images were converted to 32-bit floating-point tensors and preprocessed by the standard ResNet50 preprocessing function used for the ImageNet-pretrained backbone.
blocks.zh: 所有图像都使用TensorFlow/Keras图像数据管道被装入. 图像被调整为224×224\times 224像素,对应ResNet50使用的标准输入分辨率. 在被传递到网络之前,图像被转换为32位浮点计数器,并被用于ImageNet被预训主干线的标准ResNet50预处理功能预处理.

blocks.en: For each seed and label budget, the selected labelled indices were used to construct a dataset from the preprocessed training set. This resulting dataset was batched with a mini-batch size of 32 32 and prefetched using TensorFlow automatic tuning.
blocks.zh: 对于每个种子和标签预算,选取的标有标签的指数被用来从预处理的培训集中构建一个数据集. 由此而来的数据集被批量出一个32个小批量大小,并使用TensorFlow自动调取来预取.

blocks.en: The same preprocessing pipeline was applied to all training and test images, ensuring that differences between the supervised, active-learning, and pseudo-labeling experiments arose from the label-selection and training protocols rather than from differences in input preparation.
blocks.zh: 同样的预处理管道被应用于所有培训和测试图像,确保监督的、主动的学习和伪标签实验之间的差异产生于标签选择和培训协议,而不是来自投入准备方面的差异。

blocks.en: No data augmentation was applied in the main experiments. This provided a controlled comparison of supervised transfer learning, active learning, and pseudo-labeling under identical preprocessing and modelling conditions. Consequently, differences in performance reflect the learning strategies and label availability rather than augmentation effects.
blocks.zh: 主要试验没有应用数据增强。 这对在相同的预处理和建模条件下的有监督的转移学习、主动学习和伪标签进行了有控制的比较。 因此,业绩的差异反映了学习战略和标签的可用性,而不是增强效应。

blocks.en: 3.3 Transfer-learning backbone
blocks.zh: 3.3 转让学习主干线

blocks.en: All experiments used the same transfer-learning architecture. An ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 was selected as the backbone because it provides a strong and widely used visual feature extractor, making it well suited for benchmarking label-efficient learning strategies. The network was loaded without its original classification head using include_top=False , and a task-specific classification head was attached. The ResNet50 backbone was kept frozen throughout the benchmark using base_model.trainable = False , so that the comparisons focused on labelled-data availability and learning strategy rather than backbone fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用了相同的转移学习架构. 一种由ImageNet预选的ResNet50被选为骨干,因为它提供了强大而被广泛使用的可视特性提取器,使其非常适合为标签效率高的学习策略设定基准. 网络被装入时没有使用包含_top=False的原分类头,并附了一个任务特定分类头. ResNet50主干线在整个基准中采用Base_model被冻结。 可培训=虚假,因此比较侧重于标有标签的数据可用性和学习战略,而不是主干线微调。

blocks.en: All models were trained using sparse categorical cross-entropy loss and the Adam optimiser. To ensure that the reported label budgets did not depend on an additional labelled validation resource, no validation-loss-based early stopping, validation-based model checkpointing, or validation-based learning-rate scheduling was used. Instead, models were trained for fixed schedules, with the model obtained at the final training epoch evaluated on the independent test set. Class weights were not used; class imbalance was instead accounted for through stratified label sampling and class-sensitive evaluation metrics.

blocks.en: 3.4 Label-budget protocol and supervised baseline
blocks.zh: 3.4 标签预算协议和监督基准

blocks.en: To quantify the effect of annotation availability, models were trained using label budgets of 1 % 1\% , 3 % 3\% , 5 % 5\% , 10 % 10\% , 20 % 20\% , 40 % 40\% , and 100 % 100\% of the 10,000-image training set. For each budget, labelled samples were selected by class-stratified random sampling without replacement, retaining at least one image from each class whenever possible. This produced labelled sets of 100 100 , 299 299 , 500 500 , 1000 1000 , 2001 2001 , 3999 3999 , and 10000 10000 images, respectively; small deviations from the nominal percentages arose from class-wise rounding. The supervised baseline used only the labelled subset at each budget.
blocks.zh: 为了量化备注提供的效果,使用标签预算对模型进行了培训:1% +%、3% +%、5% +%、5% +%、10% 10 +%、20% 20 +%、40% +%、100% 100 +%。 对于每一预算,标有标签的样本都是通过分类分级的随机抽样选择的,没有替换,尽可能从每一类别中至少保留一幅图像。 这分别产生了100-100、299-299、500-500、1000-1000、2001-2001、3999-3999和10 000-1000相片的标签;按等级四舍五入,与名义百分比略有相差。 监督基准只使用每个预算中标注的子集。

blocks.en: The sampling procedure was repeated for five random seeds, 0 0 , 1 1 , 2 2 , 3 3 , and 4 4 . For each seed and label budget, a fresh ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 model with a randomly initialised classification head was trained using the architecture and optimisation framework described in Section 3.3 for a fixed schedule of 10 10 epochs. The training subset was shuffled during optimisation, while the full training set was loaded in a fixed order to ensure reproducible index-based sampling. The independent test set was not used for training, sample selection, pseudo-label generation, active-learning acquisition, or model selection, and was used only for final evaluation. The 100 % 100\% -label model served as the reference baseline for comparison with the reduced-label supervised, active-learning, and pseudo-labeling experiments.
blocks.zh: 5个随机种子,即0个、1个、2个、3个、4个,重复了取样程序。 对于每个种子和标签预算,使用第3.3节所描述的架构和优化框架,为10个10个世纪的固定时间表,培训了一个新的ImageNet预先培训的ResNet50模型,并随机输入分类头。 训练子集在优化期间被洗涤出,而完整的训练集则被固定地装入,以确保可复制的以指数为基础的取样. 独立测试集不用于培训,样本选择,伪标签生成,主动学习获取,或模型选择,仅用于最终评价. 100%的100QQ-标签模型作为参考基准,用于与受监督的减标签、主动学习和伪标签实验进行比较。

blocks.en: 3.5 Uncertainty-based active learning
blocks.zh: 3.5 基于不确定性的积极学习

blocks.en: To evaluate whether annotation efficiency could be improved by selecting informative samples, we implemented a pool-based active-learning strategy using uncertainty sampling. Active learning was evaluated at 1 % 1\% , 3 % 3\% , 5 % 5\% , 10 % 10\% , 20 % 20\% , and 40 % 40\% label budgets. The 100 % 100\% budget was excluded because no unlabelled samples remained for acquisition.
blocks.zh: 为了评估可否通过选择资料性样本来提高注解效率,我们利用不确定性样本实施了基于集合的积极学习战略。 积极学习被评为1% 1 +%,3% +%,5% 5 +%,10% 10 +%,20% 20 +%,40% 40 +% 标签预算。 100%的100-%预算被排除在外,因为没有未加标签的样本有待购买。

blocks.en:
For each random seed, active learning was initialised with the same class-stratified 1 % 1\% labelled subset used in the supervised experiments, containing 100 100 images. The remaining training images formed the initial unlabelled pool.
A model was first trained on the initial labelled subset using the fixed supervised protocol described in Section 3.3 . It was then applied to the current unlabelled pool to compute class probabilities for each unlabelled image.

blocks.zh: 4.1 监督标签效率曲线

blocks.en: We first evaluated the supervised transfer-learning baseline across label budgets to quantify how classification performance changes with decreasing annotation availability. Figure 2 shows label-budget curves for test accuracy and macro-F1, while Table 2 reports accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 values.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价了各标签预算的监督转移学习基线,以量化分类业绩如何随着备注的减少而发生变化。 图2显示了测试精度和宏-F1的标签-预算曲线,而表2报告了精度、平衡精度、宏-F1和加权-F1值。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Supervised label-budget performance of the ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 baseline on GCD. Panel (a) shows test accuracy and panel (b) shows macro-F1. Points denote the mean over five random seeds and error bars denote one standard deviation. Accuracy increases rapidly at low label budgets and begins to plateau from approximately 20 20 – 40 % 40\% labels, while macro-F1 shows a more gradual improvement with some seed-level variability.
blocks.zh: 图 2: GCD上的ImageNet-pressed ResNet50基线的监督标签-预算性能. (a)小组显示测试准确性,(b)小组显示宏观F1。 点表示平均值超过五个随机种子,出错栏表示一个标准偏差。 精确度在低标签预算下迅速上升,开始从大约20个20 — 40%的40 — — 标签走向高原,而宏观-F1则显示随着一些种子水平的可变性而出现更渐进的改善。

blocks.en: Test accuracy increased rapidly in the low-label regime and then improved more gradually as additional labels were added. With 1 % 1\% of the training labels, corresponding to 100 labelled images, the model achieved 0.6349 ± 0.0178 0.6349\pm 0.0178 accuracy, increasing to 0.7078 ± 0.0117 0.7078\pm 0.0117 at 5 % 5\% labels, 0.7237 ± 0.0035 0.7237\pm 0.0035 at 20 % 20\% , and 0.7298 ± 0.0024 0.7298\pm 0.0024 at 40 % 40\% . Under full supervision, accuracy was 0.7346 ± 0.0034 0.7346\pm 0.0034 . Thus, 20 % 20\% of the available labels recovered most of the full-label accuracy, within approximately 1.1 percentage points of the 100 % 100\% -label baseline, while 40 % 40\% labels reduced the gap to approximately 0.5 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 在低标签制度下,测试精度迅速提高,然后随着添加了额外的标签而逐步提高. 使用1%的训练标签,相当于100个标签图像,该型号在5个标签上达到0.6349±0.0178 0.6349\pm0.0178的精度,在5个标签上达到0.7078±0.0117 0.7078\pm0.0117,在20个标签上达到0.7237±0.0035 0.7237\pm0.0035,在40个标签上达到0.7298±0.024 0.7298\pm. 在全程监督下,精度为0.7346±0.0034 0.7346\pm0.0034. 因此,有20%的20分标签恢复了大部分全标签的准确性,在100%的100分标签基线的大约1.1分之内,而40%的40分标签将差距缩小到大约0.5分之内。

blocks.en: The class-balanced metrics showed a more gradual improvement and were not strictly monotonic across label budgets. Macro-F1 increased from 0.5562 ± 0.0151 0.5562\pm 0.0151 at 1 % 1\% labels to 0.6548 ± 0.0160 0.6548\pm 0.0160 at 5 % 5\% , 0.6861 ± 0.0152 0.6861\pm 0.0152 at 20 % 20\% , and 0.6997 ± 0.0073 0.6997\pm 0.0073 under full supervision. Balanced accuracy similarly increased from 0.5428 ± 0.0199 0.5428\pm 0.0199 at 1 % 1\% labels to 0.6762 ± 0.0075 0.6762\pm 0.0075 under full supervision. The small decrease in macro-F1 and balanced accuracy between 20 % 20\% and 40 % 40\% labels falls within the observed seed-level variability and should not be interpreted as a systematic degradation. Overall, the class-balanced metrics indicate that additional labelled data remained useful for improving performance across the sky-type groups, even after overall accuracy begins to show diminishing gains.
blocks.zh: 阶级平衡的衡量标准显示有更逐步的改进,而不是严格地单调地跨越标签预算。 宏-F1在1%的标签上从0.5562±0.0151 0.5562\pm 0.0151增加到了0.6548±0.0160 0.6548\pm 0.0160 在5%的标签上,0.6861±0.0152 0.6861\pm 0.0152 在20%的标签上,0.697±0.0073 0.6997\pm 0.0073 完全监督. 平衡精度同样从0.5428±0.0199 0.5428\pm 0.0199在1%的标签上提高到了0.6762±0.075 0.6762\pm 在完全监督下的0.075。 宏-F1的微小下降和20%-20%-40%-40%-40%--40%的标签属于观察到的种子水平可变性,不应被解释为系统降解。 总体而言,分类平衡的衡量标准表明,即使总体准确性开始显示收益下降,其他贴有标签的数据仍然有助于改善整个天花类组的业绩。

blocks.en: The gap between overall accuracy and class-balanced metrics suggests that label efficiency was not uniform across sky-type groups. Overall accuracy approached the full-label baseline relatively early, whereas macro-F1 and balanced accuracy improved more gradually. This indicates that the benefits of additional labels were not uniform across groups. The corresponding group-level behaviour is examined in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 总体准确度和类平衡度的度量标准之间的差距表明,各个天相类组的标签效率并不一致. 总体准确性较早接近全标签基线,而宏观-F1和平衡的准确性则较逐步地得到改进。 这表明,额外标签的好处在各群体之间并不一致。 第4.3节审查了相应的团体行为。

blocks.en: Table 2: Supervised ResNet50 performance across labelled-data budgets. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over five random seeds.
blocks.zh: 表2:监督ResNet50在贴有标签的数据预算方面的业绩。 报告结果为5个随机种子的平均±\pm标准差.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison of supervised, active-learning, and pseudo-labeling strategies
blocks.zh: 4.2 监督、积极学习和假标签战略的比较

blocks.en: We next compared the supervised stratified random-sampling, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling under matched label budgets. Figure 3 shows the test-accuracy curves up to 40 % 40\% labels, and Table 3 reports the corresponding accuracy, macro-F1, balanced accuracy, and weighted-F1 values.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来比较了监督的分层随机抽样、基于不确定性的主动学习,以及在相应的标签预算下的高自信伪标签。 图3显示的测试精确度曲线可达40%.40QQ标签,而表3则报告相应的准确度,宏-F1,平衡准确度,加权-F1值.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Label-efficiency results on GCD. Points show mean test accuracy over five random seeds and error bars show one standard deviation. The horizontal reference line indicates the 100 % 100\% -label supervised result. (a) Supervised ResNet50 performance across labelled-data budgets from 1 % 1\% to 100 % 100\% . (b) Comparison of supervised stratified random sampling, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling up to 40 % 40\% labels.
blocks.zh: 图3:标签效率在GCD上的结果。 点显示在五个随机种子上的平均测试精度,出错条显示一个标准偏差. 水平参考线表示100%的100QQ-标签监督结果. (a) 监督ResNet50在标注数据预算方面的业绩,从1%到100%到100%。 (b) 对有监督的分层随机抽样、基于不确定性的主动学习以及高达40%的40-%标签的高自信伪标签进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of supervised learning, active learning, and pseudo-labeling across labelled-data budgets. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over five random seeds.
blocks.zh: 表3:对有监督的学习、积极学习和贴有标签的数据预算的假标签的比较。 报告结果为5个随机种子的平均±\pm标准差.

blocks.en: Overall, the three strategies produced broadly similar test-accuracy curves, indicating that the frozen ResNet50 transfer-learning baseline was already highly label-efficient on GCD. With only 1 % 1\% of the training labels, supervised learning achieved 0.635 ± 0.018 0.635\pm 0.018 accuracy, while pseudo-labeling increased this to 0.646 ± 0.016 0.646\pm 0.016 . Active learning was identical to the supervised baseline at 1 % 1\% because both methods used the same initial labelled subset before any acquisition step.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这三项战略产生了大致相近的测试精确曲线,表明冻结的ResNet50转让学习基线在GCD上已经具有很高的标签效率. 由于只有1%的训练标签,监督学习达到了0.635 ± 0.018 0.635\pm 0.018的准确性,而伪标记则将这个比例提高到了0.646± 0.016 0.646\pm 0.016. 主动学习与所监督的1%.%.的基线完全相同,因为这两种方法在任何获取步骤之前都使用相同的初始子集。

blocks.en: At 3 % 3\% and 5 % 5\% labels, supervised learning achieved the highest mean accuracy, with 0.699 ± 0.006 0.699\pm 0.006 and 0.708 ± 0.012 0.708\pm 0.012 , respectively. Active learning had lower accuracy at these budgets, although its macro-F1 and balanced accuracy were competitive, particularly at 5 % 5\% labels. From 10 % 10\% labels onward, the methods became increasingly close. At 10 % 10\% labels, active learning and pseudo-labeling both reached approximately 0.718 0.718 accuracy, compared with 0.715 ± 0.014 0.715\pm 0.014 for the supervised baseline. At 40 % 40\% labels, active learning and pseudo-labeling both achieved 0.733 0.733 mean accuracy, close to the 100 % 100\% -label supervised reference of 0.735 ± 0.003 0.735\pm 0.003 .
blocks.zh: 在3%的3++和5%的5+++标签中,被监督的学习达到了最高的平均值,分别为0.699±0.006 0.699\pm 0.006和0.708±0.012. 积极学习在这些预算中的准确性较低,尽管其宏观-F1和平衡的准确性是竞争性的,特别是5%的分值。 从10%的标签开始,这些方法越来越接近。 在10%的10QQ标签中,主动学习和伪标签都达到了约0.718 0.718的精度,而监督基准的精度为0.715±0.014 0.715\pm0.014. 在40%的40分标签上,主动学习和伪标签都达到了0.733 0.733的平均准确度,接近100%的100分标签监督参考值为0.735±0.003 0.735\pm. 003。

blocks.en: Class-balanced metrics showed small advantages for the label-efficient methods at some budgets. Active learning had the highest macro-F1 at 3 % 3\% , 5 % 5\% , 10 % 10\% , and 40 % 40\% labels, while pseudo-labeling had the highest macro-F1 at 1 % 1\% and 20 % 20\% labels. However, these differences were modest in absolute terms. For example, at 40 % 40\% labels, active learning improved macro-F1 from 0.683 ± 0.012 0.683\pm 0.012 to 0.697 ± 0.007 0.697\pm 0.007 relative to supervised sampling, while test accuracy increased only from 0.730 ± 0.002 0.730\pm 0.002 to 0.733 ± 0.003 0.733\pm 0.003 .
blocks.zh: 在有些预算中,分类平衡的衡量标准对标签效率高的方法而言,优势不大。 积极学习有最高的宏-F1,比例为:3%-%;5%-%;5%-5%-%;10%-10-%;40%-40-%;而伪标签有最高的宏-F1,比例为:1%-%;20%-20-%。 然而,这些差别在绝对数字上是不大的。 例如,在40%的40QQ标签上,主动学习改进了宏-F1,从0.683±0.012 0.683\pm 0.012提高到了0.697±0.007 0.697\pm 0.007,而测试精度仅从0.730±0.002 0.730\pm 0.002提高到了0.733±0.003\p0.003.

blocks.en: To control for the additional optimisation introduced by the second pseudo-labeling stage, we also trained a continued-supervised model from the same first-stage checkpoint for the same number of optimiser updates. As shown in Appendix 8 , pseudo-labeling did not consistently outperform this update-matched control, with semi-supervised minus control differences remaining close to zero across label budgets. Thus, the apparent gains of pseudo-labeling over the first-stage supervised model should be interpreted cautiously.
blocks.zh: 为了控制由第二伪标签阶段引入的额外优化,我们还从同一个第一阶段检查站培训了一个持续监督的模型,用于相同数量的优化更新。 如附录8所显示的,伪标签没有一贯地超过这一更新匹配的控制,半监督的负控制差异在标签预算中仍然接近于零. 因此,应谨慎解释假标签在第一阶段监督模式上的明显收益。

blocks.en: These results show that simple uncertainty sampling and high-confidence pseudo-labeling remained competitive with supervised stratified sampling and produced small gains for some metrics and label budgets. However, neither method produced a large or consistent improvement over the strong transfer-learning baseline. The diagnostic analyses in Sections 4.4 and 4.5 examine possible reasons for these limited gains.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,简单的不确定性取样和高度自信的假标签仍与有监督的分层抽样有竞争力,对某些衡量和标签预算产生小收益。 然而,这两种方法都未能大大或持续地改进强有力的转移学习基线。 第4.4和4.5节的诊断分析审查了这些有限成果的可能原因。

blocks.en: 4.3 Per-class performance and confusion patterns
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 每班性能和混乱模式

blocks.en: To examine which sky-type groups contributed most to the remaining performance differences, we analysed per-class F1 scores. Table 4 reports results for the three learning strategies at 10% and 40% labels. These budgets were selected to represent an intermediate low-label setting and the largest label-efficient budget considered before full supervision.
blocks.zh: 为了检查哪些"天型"团体对剩余的性能差异贡献最大,我们分析了每等F1分. 表4报告三个学习战略的结果为10%和40%。 这些预算被选为中间低标签设置和在全面监督前考虑的最大标签效率预算。

blocks.en: Table 4: Per-class F1 scores for supervised learning, active learning, and pseudo-labeling at selected label budgets. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over five random seeds.
blocks.zh: 表4:在选定的标签预算中,用于监督学习、主动学习和伪标签的F1级分数。 报告结果为5个随机种子的平均±\pm标准差.

blocks.en: Clear sky was consistently the easiest group, with F1 scores close to 0.96 0.96 – 0.97 0.97 across methods and label budgets. Cumulus and Cumulonimbus also achieved relatively strong performance, with F1 scores around 0.71 0.71 – 0.75 0.75 . These groups contributed substantially to the high overall accuracy observed in the label-budget curves.
blocks.zh: 清空始终是最简单的组别,F1的分数接近0.96 0.96 – 0.97 0.97 跨方法和标签预算. Cumulus和Cumulonimbus也取得了相对较强的表现,F1的得分约为0.71 0.71 – 0.75 0.75. 这些组别对标签-预算曲线中观察到的高度总体准确性作出了重大贡献。

blocks.en: The most difficult groups were Mixed, Stratocumulus, and Altocumulus. Mixed had the lowest F1 scores across the selected budgets, reflecting the visual heterogeneity of this group. Active learning improved Mixed substantially relative to supervised sampling, increasing the F1 score from 0.394 ± 0.086 0.394\pm 0.086 to 0.497 ± 0.033 0.497\pm 0.033 at 10 % 10\% labels and from 0.376 ± 0.066 0.376\pm 0.066 to 0.511 ± 0.046 0.511\pm 0.046 at 40 % 40\% labels. Pseudo-labeling also improved Mixed at 40 % 40\% labels, reaching 0.471 ± 0.060 0.471\pm 0.060 , although the gain was smaller than that of active learning.
blocks.zh: 最困难的群体是混合群体、Stratocumulus和Altocumulus。 混合体在所选预算中的F1分数最低,反映了这一组的视异性。 积极学习改进 相较于监督抽样,F1分数从0.394±0.086 0.394\pm 0.086增加到了0.497±0.033 0.497\pm 0.033分,标签比例为10-%,从0.376±0.066 0.376\pm 0.066分增加到了0.511±0.046分,标签比例为40-%. 修道会标签工作也有所改善 混合在40%的40QQ标签上,达到0.471±0.060 0.471\pm 0.060,虽然收益小于主动学习.

blocks.en: Altocumulus remained challenging across methods, with F1 scores around 0.59 0.59 – 0.65 0.65 at the selected budgets. Stratocumulus also remained difficult, with F1 scores around 0.58 0.58 – 0.61 0.61 . These results indicate that the gap between overall accuracy and macro-F1 was driven by weaker performance on heterogeneous or visually overlapping groups rather than by uniform errors across all categories.
blocks.zh: 阿尔托库穆卢斯在各种方法方面依然具有挑战性,在选定的预算中,F1的得分约为0.59分 -- -- 0.59分 -- -- 0.65分。 Stratocumulus也依然困难,F1的得分约为0.58 0.58–0.61 0.61分. 这些结果表明,总体准确度与宏观F1之间的差距是由不同或视觉上相重叠的组别业绩较弱而不是由所有类别的统一错误所驱动的。

blocks.en: The class-level results are consistent with the diagnostic analyses in Sections 4.4 and 4.5 . High-confidence pseudo-labeling tended to select easier examples, while active learning queried uncertain samples from difficult groups, including Mixed and the Stratocumulus–Cumulonimbus boundary. However, these targeted acquisitions produced only modest improvements, suggesting that the remaining errors involve ambiguous or visually overlapping cases. Row-normalised confusion matrices, reported in Appendix 7 , further illustrate persistent confusion involving Mixed scenes and confusion between Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups.
blocks.zh: 班级结果与第4.4和4.5节的诊断分析一致。 高度自信的假标签往往选择比较容易的例子,而积极学习则询问来自困难群体的不确定样本,包括Mixed和Stratocumulus-Cumulonimbus边界。 然而,这些有的放矢的收购只取得了微小的改进,表明剩余的错误涉及模棱两可或视觉重叠的情况。 附录7中报告的行向常态混淆矩阵进一步说明了涉及混合场景的持续混淆以及Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus群体之间的混淆.

blocks.en: 4.4 Pseudo-label quality and selection bias
blocks.zh: 4.4 修道会标签的质量和选择偏差

blocks.en: The pseudo-labeling results in Section 4.2 showed limited improvements over the supervised and continued-supervised baselines. To understand why, we analysed the pseudo-labels accepted using the confidence threshold τ = 0.95 \tau=0.95 . Figure 4 shows accepted pseudo-label accuracy and coverage as a function of label budget, while Table 5 reports the corresponding numerical values. Class-relative pseudo-label selection diagnostics are reported in Appendix 9 .
blocks.zh: 第4.2节的伪标签结果显示,与监督和持续监督的基线相比,改进有限。 为了理解原因,我们分析了使用信任阈值= 0.95\tau= 0.95的伪标签。 图4显示公认的伪标签准确性和覆盖面,作为标签预算的一种功能,而表5则报告相应的数值. 类别相对伪标签选择诊断在附录9中报告。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Pseudo-label quality on the unlabelled training pool. Accepted pseudo-label accuracy denotes the fraction of retained pseudo-labels that matched the ground-truth labels, using training labels only for post hoc diagnostic evaluation. Coverage denotes the fraction of the unlabelled pool assigned a pseudo-label with confidence at least τ = 0.95 \tau=0.95 . Points show the mean over five random seeds and error bars show one standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 图4:无标签培训人才库上的Pseudo标签质量. 被接受的伪标签准确性表示保留了与地上真实标签相匹配的伪标签的分量,只使用训练标签进行后期诊断评价. 覆盖是指未贴标签的池中至少给定了0.95\tau=0.95的有自信的假标签。 点显示平均值超过5个随机种子,出错栏显示一个标准偏差.

blocks.en: Table 5: Pseudo-label quality across labelled-data budgets at threshold τ = 0.95 \tau=0.95 . Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over five random seeds. Coverage is the fraction of the unlabelled pool assigned a pseudo-label. Accepted accuracy is the accuracy of predictions retained as pseudo-labels, while rejected accuracy is the accuracy of predictions below the confidence threshold, computed only for diagnostic purposes.
blocks.zh: 表5:贴有标签的数据预算贴出标签的质量,阈值为: = 0.95\tau= 0.95。 报告结果为5个随机种子的平均±\pm标准差. 覆盖是未加标签的池被分配到伪标签的分数. 接受的准确性是作为伪标签保留的预测的准确性,而否定的准确性是置信阈值以下的预测的准确性,只为诊断目的计算.

blocks.en: The accepted pseudo-labels were substantially more reliable than the rejected predictions. Accepted pseudo-label accuracy ranged from 0.946 ± 0.028 0.946\pm 0.028 at 1% labels to 0.977 ± 0.003 0.977\pm 0.003 at 40% labels, whereas the accuracy of rejected predictions remained much lower. Coverage increased from 0.345 ± 0.059 0.345\pm 0.059 to 0.666 ± 0.012 0.666\pm 0.012 as the labelled-data budget increased. The absolute number of accepted pseudo-labels at 20% and 40% labels was nevertheless lower than at 10% labels, despite higher coverage, because the unlabelled pool was smaller at the larger labelled-data budgets.
blocks.zh: 公认的伪标签比被拒绝的预测要可靠得多。 接受的伪标签精度从1%标签的0.946±0.028 0.946\pm 0.028到40%标签的0.977±0.003 0.977\pm 0.003不等,而被拒绝的预测精度仍然要低得多. 随着贴有标签的数据预算增加,覆盖率从0.345±0.059 0.345\pm 0.059增加到0.666±0.012 0.666\pm 0.012。 尽管如此,20%和40%的标签被接受的绝对数量低于10%的标签,尽管覆盖面较高,因为没有标签的池在更大的标签数据预算中较小。

blocks.en: However, high pseudo-label quality did not translate into consistent gains over the update-matched continued-supervised control. This indicates that the limitation was not only pseudo-label noise, but also which samples were selected. The class-relative diagnostics in Appendix 9 show that Clear sky was consistently over-represented among accepted pseudo-labels, with enrichment above one at every budget, while Mixed was consistently under-represented, with low true-group coverage and enrichment below one. This supports the conclusion that high-confidence pseudo-labeling selected easy, visually distinctive examples more readily than ambiguous mixed-cloud scenes.
blocks.zh: 然而,高伪标签质量并没有转化为在更新匹配的持续监督控制方面的持续收益。 这表明这一限制不仅是伪标签噪音,而且还选择了哪些样本。 附录9中的类相对诊断显示,在公认的伪标签中,Clear Sky一直比例过高,每个预算的浓缩度都高于一个,而Mixed则一直代表不足,真实群体覆盖率低,浓缩度低于一个。 这支持以下结论:与模棱两可的混合云场景相比,高自信伪标签选取的简单、有视觉特色的例子更为容易。

blocks.en: This selection pattern helps explain why high-confidence pseudo-labeling did not consistently improve macro-F1 or balanced accuracy. The pseudo-labels were highly accurate, but they mainly added examples that the model already classified confidently. Consequently, they contributed relatively few additional examples from the groups associated with the remaining classification errors, particularly Mixed and visually similar groups such as Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus. Thus, in this setting, the main limitation of pseudo-labeling was not simply pseudo-label noise, but the limited additional information provided by confidence-selected pseudo-labels.
blocks.zh: 这种选择模式有助于解释为什么高自信伪标签没有连贯地提高宏-F1或平衡的准确性. 假名标签高度准确,但主要增加了模型已经自信地分类的例子. 因此,它们从与其余分类错误有关的群体,特别是Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus等混合类和视觉类群体,提供了较少的额外例子。 因此,在此设定中,伪标签的主要限制不仅仅是伪标签噪声,而是由信任所选择的伪标签提供的有限额外信息.

blocks.en: 4.5 Active-learning query behaviour
blocks.zh: 4.5 主动学习查询行为

blocks.en: We analysed the samples selected by uncertainty-based active learning to characterise the acquisition behaviour of the method. Figure 5 shows the active-query enrichment ratio for each sky-type group and acquisition step. Enrichment was computed relative to the remaining unlabelled pool immediately before each acquisition step, rather than relative to the original full training distribution. A value of one therefore indicates that the queried fraction for a class matched its availability in the current unlabelled pool, while values above one indicate over-representation and values below one indicate under-representation. The corresponding queried counts, queried fractions, pre-acquisition pool fractions, and enrichment ratios are reported in Appendix 10 .
blocks.zh: 我们分析了基于不确定因素的积极学习所选择的样本,以描述该方法的获取行为。 图5显示每个天型组和获取步骤的活性-克热浓缩比. 浓缩量是在每一购置步骤前的剩余未加标记的池中计算出来的,而不是相对于最初的全面培训分配。 因此,一个数值表明,一个类别被询问的分数与其在目前无标签的集合中的可用性相匹配,而一个数值以上表示代表过多,一个数值以下表示代表不足。 附录10报告了相应的被询问数、被询问分数、预购池分数和浓缩率。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Sky-type group enrichment among samples queried by uncertainty-based active learning. Enrichment is computed relative to the remaining unlabelled pool immediately before each acquisition step and averaged over five random seeds. Values above one indicate that a sky-type group was over-represented among queried samples relative to its availability in the current unlabelled pool, while values below one indicate under-representation. The dashed horizontal line indicates an enrichment ratio of one.Shortened labels correspond to the GCD sky-type groups defined in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 图5:对基于不确定性的主动学习提出质疑的样本中的天空型组浓缩。 浓缩量是在每个获取步骤前的剩余无标签池所计算的,平均超过5个随机种子。 一个以上的数值表明,在被询问的样本中,相对于其在现有无标签池中的可用性而言,一个天型组的代表性过高,而一个以下的数值则表明其代表性不足。 破损水平线表示浓缩比为一. 缩短的标签对应了第3.1节所定义的GCD天型组.

blocks.en: Uncertainty sampling did not simply reproduce the distribution of the remaining unlabelled pool. At the earliest acquisition step, from 1 % 1\% to 3 % 3\% labels, Mixed was strongly enriched, with an enrichment ratio of 6.26 ± 1.23 6.26\pm 1.23 , despite representing only a small fraction of the available unlabelled pool. Cirrus and Altocumulus were also over-represented at this stage, with enrichment ratios of 2.61 ± 0.80 2.61\pm 0.80 and 1.94 ± 0.74 1.94\pm 0.74 , respectively. In contrast, Clear sky was consistently under-represented across acquisition steps, indicating that the model rarely regarded Clear sky images as highly uncertain.
blocks.zh: 不确定的采样并不仅仅复制了剩余无标签池的分布。 在最早的收购阶段,从1%的1\%到3%的3\%标签,Mixed被强烈地浓缩了,浓缩比为6.26± 1.23 6.26\pm 1.23,尽管只占可用无标签池的一小部分. 在现阶段Cirrus和Altocumulus的比例也过高,浓缩率分别为2.61±0.80 2.61/pm 0.80和1.94±0.74 1.94/pm 0.74。 相比之下,Clear天空在整个获取步骤中一直代表性不足,这表明模型很少将Clear天空图像视为高度不确定.

blocks.en: At later acquisition steps, the queried samples became increasingly concentrated in the visually confusable Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups. During the 20 % → 40 % 20\%\to 40\% acquisition step, Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus accounted for the largest queried fractions, 0.360 ± 0.020 0.360\pm 0.020 and 0.365 ± 0.018 0.365\pm 0.018 , respectively. Their corresponding enrichment ratios were 2.15 ± 0.10 2.15\pm 0.10 and 1.22 ± 0.07 1.22\pm 0.07 . Mixed also remained enriched at this stage, with an enrichment ratio of 2.55 ± 0.21 2.55\pm 0.21 , although its queried fraction was smaller because few Mixed samples remained in the unlabelled pool.
blocks.zh: 在后来的获取阶段,被询问的样本越来越集中在可视同的Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus组。 在20%-40%-20%-40%-40%-40%---获取阶段,Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus分别占了最大的询问分数,分别为0.360±0.0200.360\pm0.020和0.365±0.0180.365\pm0.018。 其相应的浓缩比为2.15±0.10 2.15\pm 6.10和1.22±0.07 1.22\pm 0.07. 混合体在这一阶段还保持浓缩,浓缩比为2.55±0.21 2.55\pm 0.21,尽管它的被询问分数较小,因为混合体样本很少留在无标签的池中。

blocks.en: The analysis shows that maximum-softmax uncertainty sampling targeted sky-type groups associated with visual ambiguity, particularly Mixed in the early acquisition steps and the Stratocumulus–Cumulonimbus boundary at higher budgets. This pattern is consistent with the confusion-matrix and per-class analyses, where Mixed scenes and the Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups remained among the more difficult cases. Despite this targeted acquisition behaviour, active learning produced only limited improvement over the supervised label-budget baseline. This suggests that the remaining errors were not resolved simply by adding uncertain examples, possibly because the queried samples were difficult boundary cases, redundant within feature space, or insufficient to overcome the strong baseline provided by ImageNet-pretrained transfer learning. More sophisticated acquisition strategies, such as uncertainty combined with diversity, class-balanced uncertainty sampling, or methods explicitly targeting persistent confusion pairs, may be needed to obtain larger gains.
blocks.zh: 分析显示,最大软度不确定性取样针对与视觉模糊有关的天型群体,特别是早期获取步骤和较高预算的Stratocumulus-Cumunimbus边界的混合体。 这种模式符合混乱-矩阵和每类分析,其中混合场景和Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus群体仍然是比较困难的案件。 尽管采取了这种针对性的收购行为,但积极的学习与监督的标签-预算基线相比只取得了有限的改进。 这表明,剩下的错误不是仅仅通过增加不确定的例子来解决的,可能是因为被询问的样本是难以解决的边界问题,在特征空间内是多余的,或者不足以克服ImageNet预先训练的转移学习所提供的强大基线。 为了取得更大的收益,可能需要更复杂的获取战略,如不确定性与多样性相结合、阶级平衡的不确定性取样或明确针对持续混淆对的方法。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: In this study, we investigated label-efficient ground-based cloud classification on GCD using a frozen ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 backbone. We compared supervised stratified sampling, uncertainty-based active learning, and high-confidence pseudo-labeling under matched label budgets and a fixed training protocol. The main finding is that the supervised transfer-learning baseline was already highly label-efficient. Test accuracy increased rapidly from 1 % 1\% to 5 % 5\% labels and then improved more gradually, with diminishing gains at larger label budgets. With 20 20 – 40 % 40\% of the training labels, performance approached that obtained with the full labelled set. This suggests that generic visual features learned from ImageNet can transfer effectively to ground-based cloud imagery, even when the labelled pool is severely limited.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们利用被冷冻的ImageNet预先训练的ResNet50主干线,对GCD上的标签高效地基云分类进行了调查. 我们比较了有监督的分层抽样、基于不确定因素的积极学习、以及根据相应的标签预算和一项固定的培训协议进行高度自信的假标签。 主要调查结果是,受监督的转让学习基线已经具有很高的标签效率。 测试精度迅速从1%的1%提高到5%的5%的5%的标签,然后逐步改进,在更大的标签预算中收益不断减少。 20 – 40% – 40% 的训练标签, 性能接近 获得的全标签集。 这表明从ImageNet学来的一般视觉特征可以有效地转移到地基云图像上,即使被标注的集合受到严重的限制.

blocks.en: However, class-balanced metrics showed a more nuanced picture. Although overall accuracy approached the full-label result relatively early, macro-F1 and balanced accuracy improved more gradually as additional labels were added. This indicates that the benefits of additional annotation were not uniform across sky-type groups. The per-class analysis confirmed this interpretation. Clear sky was classified accurately across all budgets, whereas Mixed, Altocumulus, and Stratocumulus remained persistently challenging. Mixed scenes were particularly difficult, likely because they contain visual characteristics associated with multiple sky-type groups. The persistent confusion between the Stratocumulus/Stratus/Altostratus and Cumulonimbus/Nimbostratus groups further suggests that some errors arise from substantial visual overlap rather than simply insufficient labelled data.
blocks.zh: 然而,阶级平衡的衡量标准显示出更细微的变化。 虽然总体准确性接近全标签结果相对较早,但随着添加了额外的标签,宏观-F1和平衡的准确性得到更渐进的提高. 这表明,不同天型组别增加注释的好处并不一致。 每类分析证实了这一解释。 对所有预算都精确地划分出晴天,而混合、上层和斯特拉托库穆卢斯则始终具有挑战性。 混合场景尤其困难,可能是因为其中包含与多组天空型相联的视觉特征. Stratocumulus/Stratus/Altostratus和Cumulonimbus/Nimbostratus两个小组之间持续存在的混淆进一步表明,一些错误是由于视觉重叠造成的,而不是仅仅由于贴有标签的数据不足造成的。

blocks.en: The active-learning results show that maximum-softmax uncertainty sampling was competitive with supervised stratified sampling and provided small improvements for some class-balanced metrics. In particular, active learning improved performance on Mixed at selected budgets and achieved the highest macro-F1 at several label budgets. However, these gains were modest and did not translate into a large improvement in overall accuracy. The query-enrichment analysis showed that uncertainty sampling did not simply reproduce the distribution of the remaining unlabelled pool. Instead, it strongly enriched Mixed during the earliest acquisition step and later concentrated on the visually confusable Stratocumulus and Cumulonimbus groups, while consistently under-selecting Clear sky. Thus, the limited gains were not because active learning failed to query difficult sky-type groups. Rather, the queried samples may have represented difficult boundary cases, partially redundant examples, or insufficient additional information to overcome the strong transfer-learning baseline.
blocks.zh: 积极学习的结果表明,最大软度不确定性抽样与受监督的分层抽样具有竞争力,为一些分类平衡的衡量标准提供了小幅改进。 特别是,在选定的预算中,积极学习混合项目的业绩有所改善,在几个标榜预算中实现了最高的宏观-F1。 然而,这些进展不大,没有转化为总体准确性的重大改进。 查询-浓缩分析显示,不确定性抽样并不只是重复剩余无标签池的分布。 相反,它在最早的获取阶段就大力丰富了Mixid,后来集中于可视相容的Stratocumulus和Cumulonimbus组,同时始终未充分选择Clear Sky. 因此,收益有限并不是因为积极学习未能询问困难的天空类型群体。 相反,被询问的样本可能代表了困难的边界案例、部分多余的例子或不足以克服强有力的转移学习基线的额外信息。

blocks.en: High-confidence pseudo-labeling also produced only limited gains. At higher budgets, it slightly improved accuracy or macro-F1 relative to the first-stage supervised model, but the controlled comparison showed that pseudo-labeling did not consistently outperform an update-matched continued-supervised control. This indicates that part of the apparent benefit may have resulted from additional optimisation rather than from the pseudo-labelled samples themselves. The pseudo-label quality analysis showed that accepted pseudo-labels were substantially more accurate than rejected predictions, so the limitation was not primarily pseudo-label noise. Instead, the class-relative diagnostics showed a selection effect: the confidence threshold preferentially accepted easier or more visually distinctive sky-type groups, especially Clear sky, while Mixed remained under-represented relative to its difficulty. As a result, pseudo-labeling added many reliable examples, but not necessarily the examples most likely to improve class-balanced performance.
blocks.zh: 高度自信的假标签也只产生有限的收益. 在较高的预算中,与第一阶段监督模型相比,它略微提高了准确度或宏观-F1,但控制性比较表明,伪标签并非一贯地超过更新匹配的继续监督控制. 这表明,部分明显的好处可能是额外的优化,而不是假标签样品本身。 伪标签质量分析显示,被接受的伪标签比被否决的预测要准确得多,因此限制主要不是伪标签噪声. 相反,类相对诊断显示出一种选择效果:置信阈值优先被接受更容易或更具有视觉特色的天空型组,特别是Clear天空,而相较于其难度,Mixid仍然代表性不足. 因此,伪标签增加了许多可靠的例子,但不一定是最有可能改善阶级平衡性能的例子.

blocks.en: Overall, these findings suggest that simple label-efficient strategies provide limited additional benefit when the supervised transfer-learning baseline is already strong. A relatively small labelled subset may be sufficient to obtain strong overall accuracy on GCD, but improving performance on ambiguous sky-type groups requires more targeted approaches. The results also show why diagnostic analyses are important: pseudo-labeling and active learning can produce similar aggregate performance while behaving differently in terms of sample selection. Pseudo-labeling mainly adds high-confidence examples, whereas uncertainty sampling actively queries ambiguous examples. Nevertheless, neither strategy fully resolved the persistent group-level errors.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些调查结果表明,如果监督的转移学习基线已经很强,简单的标签效率战略提供的附加效益是有限的。 贴上相对小标签的子集可能足以在GCD上获得强烈的总体准确性,但改善模棱两可的天空类组的性能需要更有针对性的方法. 结果还显示了诊断分析之所以重要的原因:伪标签和活性学习可以产生相似的整体性能,同时在样本选择方面表现不同. Pseudo-labeling主要增加了高自信的例子,而不确定性抽样则积极询问模棱两可的例子. 然而,这两项战略都没有完全解决长期存在的集团一级错误。

blocks.en: Several directions could improve upon these baselines. For pseudo-labeling, class-aware thresholds, calibration-aware confidence scores, or methods that explicitly balance pseudo-label selection across sky-type groups may reduce the bias toward easy high-confidence examples. For active learning, uncertainty could be combined with diversity, representation-space coverage, or class-conditional acquisition objectives to reduce redundant selections and improve coverage of difficult regions. Hybrid active semi-supervised approaches may also be useful, for example by using active learning to label difficult regions of the feature space while using pseudo-labeling for reliable high-confidence samples.
blocks.zh: 在这些基线方面,有几个方向可以改进。 对于伪标签,班级意识阈值,校准意识信心分数,或者明确平衡全天型组的伪标签选择的方法,可以减少对轻松高自信例子的偏向. 就积极学习而言,不确定性可以与多样性、代表性-空间覆盖面或有条件的获得目标相结合,以减少多余的选择并增加困难区域的覆盖面。 混合活性半监督方法也可能有用,例如利用活性学习来给特征空间的困难区域贴上标签,同时使用假标签来取取可靠的高自信样本.

blocks.en: This study has several limitations. First, the benchmark used a single frozen backbone architecture and a fixed preprocessing pipeline. This design enabled a controlled comparison of learning strategies, but other architectures, fine-tuning protocols, or augmentation strategies may yield different absolute performance. Second, the active-learning and pseudo-labeling methods were deliberately simple baselines; more advanced strategies may perform differently. Third, the analysis was restricted to GCD, so the conclusions should be validated on additional ground-based cloud datasets with different imaging conditions, class definitions, and geographic settings. Despite these limitations, the results provide a reproducible benchmark for label-efficient ground-based cloud classification and highlight the importance of class-level diagnostics when evaluating active and semi-supervised learning methods.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些局限性。 首先,该基准使用了单一被冻结的骨干结构和固定的预处理管道。 这种设计能够对学习策略进行有控制的比较,但其他架构,微调协议,或增强策略可能会产生不同的绝对性能. 第二,积极学习和假标签方法是故意简单的基线;更先进的战略可能效果不同。 第三,分析仅限于GCD,因此,结论应验证于具有不同成像条件、分类定义和地理环境的其他地基云数据集。 尽管有这些限制,结果为标签高效地基云分级提供了一个可再生的基准,并突出了阶级级诊断在评价主动和半监督学习方法时的重要性.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study presented a systematic benchmark of label-efficient learning strategies for ground-based cloud classification on GCD. Under matched label budgets and a fixed training protocol, supervised transfer learning with a frozen ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 backbone proved highly label-efficient. Test accuracy increased rapidly at low label budgets, and using only 20 20 – 40 % 40\% of the available training labels approached the performance obtained with the full labelled set.
blocks.zh: 这项研究为全球监测数据中的地基云分级提供了标签效率高的学习战略的系统基准。 在相应的标签预算和固定培训协议下,采用被冻结的ImageNet pressed ResNet50主干线进行监督的转移学习证明具有很高的标签效率。 在低标签预算中,测试精度迅速提高,只使用20 20 — 40% — 40%的可用培训标签接近了用全套标签获得的性能。

blocks.en: Active learning and high-confidence pseudo-labeling provided only limited additional benefit over the supervised baseline. The results show that the main challenge was not simply the number of labelled images, but the difficulty of improving performance on visually ambiguous sky-type groups. Pseudo-labeling produced reliable high-confidence labels, but these were biased toward easier sky-type groups and did not consistently outperform an update-matched continued-supervised control. In contrast, uncertainty-based active learning did query difficult groups, including Mixed and the Stratocumulus–Cumulonimbus boundary, but these targeted acquisitions produced only modest improvements in overall performance.
blocks.zh: 积极的学习和高度自信的假标签比监督基线只提供了有限的额外好处。 结果显示,主要挑战不仅仅是标有标签的图像数量,而是在视觉上模棱两可的天空类型团体上提高性能的困难. Pseudo-labeling生产出可靠的高自信标签,但这些标签偏向于更简单的"天空型"组合,并且没有一贯地超越更新匹配的继续监督控制. 与此相反,基于不确定性的积极学习的确询问了困难群体,包括Mixed和Stratocumulus - Cumulonimbus边界,但这些有针对性的收购只是使总体业绩略有改善。

blocks.en: Overall, these results provide a reproducible benchmark for label-efficient ground-based cloud classification and show that strong transfer-learning baselines are difficult to improve with simple active or semi-supervised strategies. Future gains are likely to require more targeted methods, such as class-aware pseudo-labeling, uncertainty sampling combined with diversity, or hybrid active semi-supervised approaches designed specifically for visually ambiguous sky-type groups.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果为标签效率高的地基云分类提供了一个可再生基准,并表明,采用简单的主动或半监督战略,很难改进强有力的转移学习基线。 未来的收益很可能需要更有针对性的方法,例如班级认知伪标签、不确定性取样与多样性相结合,或专门为视似模糊的天空类型群体设计的混合活性半监督方法。

blocks.en: 7 Supervised confusion matrices
blocks.zh: 7 监督混淆矩阵

blocks.en: Figure 6 reports row-normalised confusion matrices for the supervised ResNet50 baseline at selected label budgets. These matrices complement the per-class F1 analysis in Section 4.3 by showing the main error patterns between GCD sky-type groups. Across the selected label budgets, Clear sky is classified with high recall, whereas the main persistent errors involve Mixed scenes and confusion between visually similar groups, particularly Stratocumulus/Stratus/Altostratus and Cumulonimbus/Nimbostratus.

blocks.en: 9 Class-relative pseudo-label selection
blocks.zh: 第9条 类相对伪标签选择

blocks.en: Table 7 reports class-relative pseudo-label selection diagnostics for the high-confidence pseudo-labeling experiment at threshold τ = 0.95 \tau=0.95 . These diagnostics account for the different class sizes in the unlabelled pool. The accepted true count is the number of unlabelled samples from a given true class that passed the confidence threshold. True-class coverage is the fraction of unlabelled samples from that true class that were accepted as pseudo-labels. Accepted enrichment compares the accepted true-class fraction with the corresponding class fraction in the unlabelled pool. Predicted-class precision is the pooled precision among accepted pseudo-labels assigned to the corresponding predicted class.
blocks.zh: 表7汇报了高自信伪标签试验的分类相对伪标签选择诊断 \ = 0.95\ tau= 0.95 这些诊断法说明了无标签池中不同的类大小. 被接受的真数是来自特定真实类的未加标签的样本数量,这些样本已超过置信阈值. True-class覆盖是该真实类中被接受为伪标签的无标签样本的一小部分. 接受的丰富度将接受的正等分数与未加标签的集合中的相应分数进行比较。 预测类精度是指定给相应预测类的公认伪标签之间的集合精度.

blocks.en: Table 7: Class-relative pseudo-label selection diagnostics at threshold τ = 0.95 \tau=0.95 . Accepted true counts are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over five random seeds, with zero-selection seeds included. True-class coverage and accepted enrichment are computed from pooled counts across seeds. Predicted-class precision is the pooled precision among accepted pseudo-labels assigned to each class.
blocks.zh: 表7:门槛值=0.95\tau=0.95的类相对伪标签选择诊断. 接受的真数作为5个随机种子的平均值±\pm标准偏差报告,其中包含零选种子. 真正等级的覆盖面和接受的丰富程度是根据各种种子的集合计数计算的。 预想类精度是分配给每个类的公认伪标签之间的集合精度.

blocks.en: 10 Active-learning queried-class distribution and enrichment
blocks.zh: 10 积极学习问班分布和丰富

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the sky-type-group composition of samples acquired by uncertainty-based active learning at each acquisition step. Queried counts, queried fractions, pre-acquisition pool fractions, and enrichment ratios are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over five random seeds. The queried fraction denotes the proportion of the acquired batch belonging to each sky-type group. The pool fraction denotes the proportion of the remaining unlabelled pool belonging to that sky-type group immediately before the acquisition step. Enrichment is defined as the ratio between the queried fraction and this pre-acquisition pool fraction. Values above one indicate that a sky-type group was over-represented among queried samples relative to its availability in the current unlabelled pool, while values below one indicate under-representation.
blocks.zh: 表8报告每个获取步骤中通过基于不确定性的主动学习获得的样本的天空类型组组成. 盘点数,盘点分数,收购前池分数,浓缩率报告为5个随机种子的平均值±\pm标准差. 被询问分数表示获得的批次中属于每个天空类型组的比例。 该池分数表示在获取步骤之前属于该天空型组的剩余无标签池的比例。 浓缩被定义为被询问分数与该预购集合分数之间的比例. 一个以上的数值表明,在被询问的样本中,相对于其在现有无标签池中的可用性而言,一个天型组的代表性过高,而一个以下的数值则表明其代表性不足。

blocks.en: Zero-count classes are included when computing the means and standard deviations. This table complements the active-learning diagnostics in Section 4.5 by showing both the absolute number and relative fraction of queried samples from each sky-type group.
